messages:
Maya: Quick sync — landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Goal: clear CTAs so visitors know self-serve vs sales route.

Rafael: Hosted hero ideas:
- "Hosted API — instant API access for text & embeddings"
- "Production-grade hosted inference, no infra"

Zoe: I prefer the second. Add tiny chips under hero: "median latency ~75ms" and "free credits". Keep CTA minimal.

Carter: Routing rules: Hosted CTA -> self-serve signup & API key issuance. Dedicated/Private CTAs -> gated "Request quote" form -> CRM lead tagged (dedicated/private). Form fields: ARR bracket, estimated monthly tokens, preferred cloud/on-prem, compliance checkboxes.

Emi: CTA microcopy proposals:
- Hosted: "Start free — no credit card"
- Dedicated: "Request reserved capacity"
- Private: "Talk to sales — private deployment"

Rafael: Quick A/B test snippet for infra (benefit vs proof):
```
{"experiment":"hosted_hero_v1","variants":[{"id":"benefit","headline":"Ship LLM features fast, no infra"},{"id":"proof","headline":"Proven in production: predictable latency"}],"metric":"signup_rate"}
```

forms-bot: Reminder — include hidden fields utm_source, utm_medium, first_touch. Append channel tag and ensure compliance checkbox routes to Compliance SE queue.

Zoe: On the page add a small compare row for Deployment time (minutes / days / weeks) and Support level (Docs / SE & SLA / Enterprise). Add a one-line Dedicated testimonial: "Dedicated pools removed our bursty latency." — initials OK.

Maya: Actions: Rafael finalize hero lines; Zoe produce mockups; Carter implement form schema + routing; Emi finalize CTAs. Review next Wednesday. Thanks!
